# Workshop Settings

Source: [wiki article 2168](../archive/2168.md); edited 2024-06-09.

<a id="wiki-2168-n1"></a>

- Workshop settings/menu are created merely by using Workshop Setting values in rules; every setting name must be unique.

<a id="wiki-2168-n2"></a>

- Categories are case-sensitive and appear in script order; inside each category settings sort by ascending sort order, then alphanumerically.

<a id="wiki-2168-n3"></a>

- Combo evaluates to a zero-based option index; Hero returns a Hero; Integer and Real ranges include endpoints; Toggle returns Boolean.
